engines: oden 2.9.7 (release, with WAL-checkpoint fix) · deno 2.9.7 (stable) · bun 1.4.3 · node 22.21.1
caveat: All binaries are optimized release builds measured in the same session (hyperfine, 30-60 runs, 10 warmups). oden includes the new cache-DB WAL checkpoint fix (startup no longer re-reads megabytes of uncheckpointed WAL frames — a 2.4MB WAL is folded into the main DB on first open). bun npm number uses bare import (bun 1.4 dropped the `npm:` specifier prefix); same node_modules workload.
